program.title: Interview drills
program.goal: Walk in with lines you have already said aloud: the opener, your stories, what to say if an answer goes wrong, and your questions for them.

courses.title: Interview drills
courses.summary: Say each card aloud, then rate how it went. Your ratings go back to Udyoga.

courses.title: Pre-interview routine
courses.summary: A checklist for the day before and the last half hour.

topics.title: The day before
topics.details: Check the route, or test the video link, camera and microphone. Read your questions for them. Read your story cards once. Read the values in the job pack.

topics.title: 30 minutes before
topics.details: Say two short answers aloud as a warm-up: the settler and one story.

topics.title: 5 minutes before
topics.details: A few slow breaths. Have your one-line opening ready: who you are and why this role.

topics.title: In the room
topics.details: It is fine to pause, to ask for a question again, or to jot a note. Panels expect nerves; no-one answers every question perfectly.

topics.title: Optional: "I'm excited"
topics.details: If your heart is racing before you go in, try saying to yourself "I'm excited" rather than trying to calm down: a racing heart is your body getting ready. Small effect in studies; try it, keep it if it helps.

courses.title: Video interview setup
courses.summary: Check each before a video or phone interview.

topics.title: Connection
topics.details: Use a wired or strong connection; close other apps that use the network.

topics.title: Sound
topics.details: Headphones or a headset; test the microphone in the meeting app first.

topics.title: Light and framing
topics.details: Light in front of you, not behind; head and shoulders in frame.

topics.title: Eye line
topics.details: Camera at eye height. Looking at the camera when you make a point is optional.

topics.title: Notes
topics.details: A few keywords near the camera at most: reading a script shows on video.

topics.title: Interruptions
topics.details: Phone on silent, door closed, notifications off.

topics.title: If it drops
topics.details: Have the panel's phone number ready; rejoin, then say where you were up to.

cards.front: Could you start by telling us a little about your current role?
cards.back: About a minute: your role now, one thing you are proud of in it, and why this job is the next step.

cards.front: Your story in three bullets: Clinic diary clash
cards.back:
- The clinic diary was double-booked most Mondays.
- I rang each patient on the list and moved the overflow to a Tuesday session.
- Double bookings fell from nine a week to one.

cards.front: Recovery line: Your example felt weak as you finished it
cards.back: Can I come back to that with a better example?

cards.front: Recovery line: You said "we" all through and the panel cannot tell what you did
cards.back: To be clear about my own part in that: I…

cards.front: Recovery line: You stopped before saying how it turned out
cards.back: Could I briefly add how that turned out?

cards.front: Recovery line: You lost the thread of a long answer
cards.back: To sum up: the result was…, and next time I would…

cards.front: Recovery line: You have not done exactly what they asked about
cards.back: I have not done exactly that, but the closest I have come is…

cards.front: Recovery line: You did not catch the question
cards.back: Sorry, could you say the question again?

cards.front: Recovery line: Your mind went blank
cards.back: Can I take a moment to think about that?

cards.front: Do you have any questions for us?
cards.back:
- What would success look like at six months?
- What are the biggest pressures on the team right now?
- How does the team share learning when something goes wrong?

cards.front: Your heart is racing as you wait to go in
cards.back: If your heart is racing before you go in, try saying to yourself "I'm excited" rather than trying to calm down: a racing heart is your body getting ready. Small effect in studies; try it, keep it if it helps.

notes.title: From Udyoga: interview drills
notes.body:
Made by Udyoga from your story bank and your questions for them. Sending again updates these cards and keeps your reviews.

The "I'm excited" card is optional. Small effect in studies; try it, keep it if it helps.
